lines.zh: 我走起来嗡嗡响，像远处在打雷。
lines.en: I buzz as I walk, like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 六条腿轮流落地，声音很轻。
lines.en: My six legs land in turn, very softly.

lines.zh: 我不是来炸你的，名字起错了。
lines.en: I am not here to bomb you; my name is wrong.

lines.zh: 我低低地飞一段，再落地走走。
lines.en: I hum low for a stretch, then settle and walk.

lines.zh: 这一路我停了三回，吃草籽。
lines.en: I stopped three times along this way for grass seeds.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀太薄，风一大就歪。
lines.en: My wings are so thin that a strong gust tilts me.

lines.zh: 草尖被我碰得直晃。
lines.en: The tips of the grass sway where I brush them.

lines.zh: 跟着我走，前面有熟透的果子。
lines.en: Walk with me; ripe fruit lies ahead.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，因为壳会磕响。
lines.en: I walk around stones because my shell rattles.

lines.zh: 飞行很费劲，我更愿意爬。
lines.en: Flying tires me; I would rather crawl.

lines.zh: 我头顶那层膜一颤一颤的。
lines.en: The membrane on my head quivers as I go.

lines.zh: 气味引路，我一路闻到西边。
lines.en: Scent leads me; I have followed it westward.

lines.zh: 不急，我这一路要吃到天黑。
lines.en: No rush; I plan to eat my way until dark.

lines.zh: 脚下的土是暖的，我就走这边。
lines.en: The soil is warm underfoot, so I take this side.

lines.zh: 我飞一段就歇一段，壳太沉。
lines.en: I fly a stretch and rest a stretch; my shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 我沿着草地边缘走，那里有花。
lines.en: I walk the meadow's edge, where the flowers are.

lines.zh: 我停在叶子上，慢慢收翅膀。
lines.en: I stop on a leaf and slowly fold my wings.

lines.zh: 肚子饿了，我先歇一会儿。
lines.en: I am hungry, but first I will rest a while.

lines.zh: 阳光晒在壳上，暖得正好。
lines.en: Sunlight on my shell is exactly warm enough.

lines.zh: 我嗡嗡两声，只是自己在哼。
lines.en: I hum twice, just humming to myself.

lines.zh: 这片草籽，够我磨到明年。
lines.en: These grass seeds will last me until next year.

lines.zh: 有只小虫爬过去，我没动。
lines.en: A small bug crawled past; I did not move.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有细纹，像地图。
lines.en: Fine lines on my shell look like a map.

lines.zh: 我抬着头，等风把气味送来。
lines.en: I raise my head and wait for the wind to bring scent.

lines.zh: 想睡，可翅膀还想抖一抖。
lines.en: I want to sleep, but my wings still want to quiver.

lines.zh: 天界的光太亮，我眯着眼。
lines.en: The light of this realm is bright; I squint.

lines.zh: 我数叶脉，数到第七根就忘了。
lines.en: I count leaf veins, and forget at the seventh.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我听见自己心跳。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I can hear my own heart beating.

lines.zh: 你站得这么近，我有点紧张。
lines.en: You stand so close; I am a little nervous.

lines.zh: 你手里没有吃的，对吧。
lines.en: You are not holding food. Right?

lines.zh: 仰头看你，我的颈膜都绷紧。
lines.en: Looking up at you, the membrane on my neck tightens.

lines.zh: 你一站过来，我就落在暗里。
lines.en: You step over and I fall into your shade.

lines.zh: 你没带吃的，我就离远一点。
lines.en: No food on you, so I keep a little distance.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比我大好多。
lines.en: Your eyes are so much bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 你要摸我吗，轻一点。
lines.en: Are you going to touch me? Be gentle.

lines.zh: 我叫一声给你听，别笑。
lines.en: I will call once for you. Do not laugh.

lines.zh: 你袖口有果皮的味道，酸的。
lines.en: Your cuff smells of fruit peel. Sour.

lines.zh: 我们就这样对看着，也挺好。
lines.en: Just looking at each other like this is fine too.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，我壳都震了。
lines.en: That hurt; my shell is still ringing.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一缩，就躲不开了。
lines.en: My wings fold in and I cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 我挡在中间，是因为飞不动。
lines.en: I am in the way because I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 壳上那道缝，在渗甜水。
lines.en: That seam in my shell is leaking sweet fluid.

lines.zh: 疼，但我还是不想还手。
lines.en: It hurts, but I still do not want to fight back.

lines.zh: 我哼的调子，被你打歪了。
lines.en: The note I hum has been knocked off pitch.

lines.zh: 你力气好大，我飞不稳了。
lines.en: You are so strong; I cannot fly straight.

lines.zh: 疼得我把自己卷成一个核。
lines.en: It hurts enough to roll myself into a pit.

lines.zh: 我身上掉了一点粉。
lines.en: A little of my dust fell off.

lines.zh: 别打了，我可以走开。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I can just leave.

lines.zh: 那团甜甜的，是递给我的？
lines.en: That sweet bundle, is it being offered to me?

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味了，从你那边来的。
lines.en: I smell something sweet, coming from your side.

lines.zh: 你的手太远，我的翅膀够不到。
lines.en: Your hand is too far; my wings cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 这味道让我翅膀自己抖起来。
lines.en: This smell makes my wings quiver on their own.

lines.zh: 我吃过一次这种东西，记到现在。
lines.en: I ate this once and remember it still.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我是真的饿了。
lines.en: Do not tease me; I am truly hungry.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我自己过去。
lines.en: Set the food down and I will come to it.

lines.zh: 吃了你的东西，我就跟着你走。
lines.en: Once I eat your food, I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我要一小口，就一小口。
lines.en: Just one small bite. Only one.

lines.zh: 你走开，食物留下，这样最好。
lines.en: You go, leave the food, and everything is perfect.

lines.zh: 撞到我壳上了，有点响。
lines.en: You bumped my shell, and it rang a little.

lines.zh: 对不起，我走路不看前面。
lines.en: Sorry, I do not watch where I walk.

lines.zh: 你推得我歪了一下。
lines.en: Your push tilted me to one side.

lines.zh: 我的壳是硬的，你别磕疼了。
lines.en: My shell is hard; do not hurt yourself on it.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，谁也过不去。
lines.en: We are jammed together and neither can pass.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要去那片叶子。
lines.en: Make room; I am heading for that leaf.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的腿了，就一下。
lines.en: You stepped on my leg. Just once.

lines.zh: 你贴上来，我的壳都被压热。
lines.en: You lean in and my shell warms where you press.

lines.zh: 我身上有粉，蹭到你衣服上了。
lines.en: I have dust on me, and it rubbed onto your clothes.

lines.zh: 碰一下不要紧，我的壳有弹性。
lines.en: A little bump is fine; my shell flexes.

lines.zh: 你要是带吃的来，我就考虑。
lines.en: Bring food and I will consider it.

lines.zh: 我们得先互相闻闻。
lines.en: We should sniff each other first.

lines.zh: 别急，我还得吃饱。
lines.en: Not yet; I still need to eat my fill.

lines.zh: 两颗心靠近，会一起嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Two hearts close together hum in unison.

lines.zh: 我的同类都很温和，跟我一样。
lines.en: My kind are all gentle, like me.

lines.zh: 你退开点，给我们留地方。
lines.en: Step back and give us some room.

lines.zh: 这事要看季节，不是看心情。
lines.en: This depends on the season, not on mood.

lines.zh: 翅膀碰翅膀，就算答应了。
lines.en: Wing against wing, and that counts as yes.

lines.zh: 我们会找个安静的草窝。
lines.en: We will find a quiet nest in the grass.

lines.zh: 别盯着看，我会害羞。
lines.en: Do not stare; I get shy.

lines.zh: 地上这颗种子，我捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up this seed from the ground.

lines.zh: 你要这个吗，我可以让给你。
lines.en: Do you want this? I can let you have it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只是想看看。
lines.en: I pick things up only to look at them.

lines.zh: 这块亮亮的，能吃不。
lines.en: This shiny thing, can it be eaten?

lines.zh: 我拿不动太重的。
lines.en: I cannot carry anything too heavy.

lines.zh: 掉了就捡，捡了就忘。
lines.en: I drop it, I pick it up, I forget it.

lines.zh: 你掉的线头，我绕在腿上了。
lines.en: The thread you dropped is tangled on my leg.

lines.zh: 我把它推到草里藏好。
lines.en: I push it into the grass to hide it.

lines.zh: 这个不甜，我不要了。
lines.en: This is not sweet. I am done with it.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西，我会分你一半。
lines.en: Whatever I find, I will share half with you.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，我去看看。
lines.en: Something moved over there; I will go look.

lines.zh: 空气里有烂熟的甜味，在那边。
lines.en: There is an overripe sweetness in the air, over there.

lines.zh: 你不是敌人，我确认过了。
lines.en: You are not an enemy. I checked.

lines.zh: 有个影子在草里窜。
lines.en: A shadow is darting through the grass.

lines.zh: 我好奇，所以朝你这边来。
lines.en: I am curious, so I am coming your way.

lines.zh: 那边好像有吃的，我先过去。
lines.en: There seems to be food there; I will go first.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我只跟着味道。
lines.en: I do not chase people; I follow smells.

lines.zh: 你走得慢，我就跟上了。
lines.en: You walk slowly, so I caught up.

lines.zh: 这片地我熟，跟我来。
lines.en: I know this ground. Come with me.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是想靠近看看。
lines.en: Do not worry; I only want a closer look.

lines.zh: 我的触角先碰到你了。
lines.en: My antenna touched you first.

lines.zh: 那边的草在动，是风还是别的。
lines.en: The grass moves over there. Wind, or something else?

lines.zh: 我盯着那片草，眼睛都不眨。
lines.en: I stare at that patch of grass without blinking.

lines.zh: 你在动，我就跟着动。
lines.en: When you move, I move with you.

lines.zh: 我不擅长盯人，容易走神。
lines.en: I am bad at staring; my mind wanders.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我先退到叶背去。
lines.en: Raise your hand and I first back under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我看看你要做什么。
lines.en: Let me see what you are going to do.

lines.zh: 你的影子一晃，我就缩翅膀。
lines.en: One flicker of your shadow and I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，是在判断距离。
lines.en: I tilt my head to judge the distance.

lines.zh: 你要是抬手打，我就飞走。
lines.en: If you raise a hand to hit, I will fly off.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里，你有好多只手。
lines.en: In my compound eyes you have so many hands.

lines.zh: 我就这么看着，不动。
lines.en: I will just watch like this, without moving.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道变了，紧张了。
lines.en: Your smell changed. You are nervous.

lines.zh: 我记住你的样子了，慢慢看。
lines.en: I am memorizing your shape, taking my time.

lines.zh: 我不会打架，这一下是撞的。
lines.en: I cannot fight; that was just a bump.

lines.zh: 我顶你一下，是想让你让开。
lines.en: I butted you to make you move aside.

lines.zh: 我的腿细，打不疼人。
lines.en: My legs are thin and cannot hurt anyone.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，急了只会横冲。
lines.en: I do not bite; cornered, I only charge sideways.

lines.zh: 这点力气，连草茎都撞不断。
lines.en: This much force would not even snap a stalk.

lines.zh: 我翅膀扇到你脸了，抱歉。
lines.en: My wing brushed your face. Sorry.

lines.zh: 我从来不想伤人。
lines.en: I never wanted to hurt anyone.

lines.zh: 你退后，我就不撞了。
lines.en: Step back and I will stop bumping you.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞上去，自己更疼。
lines.en: When my shell hits, I am the one hurting more.

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，算躲。
lines.en: That was not an attack; that was dodging.

lines.zh: 我从光里落下来，摔了一下。
lines.en: I fell out of the light and landed hard.

lines.zh: 这里草软，适合落脚。
lines.en: The grass is soft here, good for landing.

lines.zh: 我刚孵出来，还站不太稳。
lines.en: I just hatched and cannot stand steadily yet.

lines.zh: 天界太高，我飘了很久才到。
lines.en: The realm is high; I drifted a long while to get here.

lines.zh: 我的壳还是软的，别碰。
lines.en: My shell is still soft. Do not touch it.

lines.zh: 这一片我没来过，先闻闻。
lines.en: I have never been here; let me sniff around.

lines.zh: 膜翅晾干了，我才敢离地。
lines.en: Once my wings dry, I dare leave the ground.

lines.zh: 我落在一朵花旁边，正好。
lines.en: I landed beside a flower. Perfect.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，光有点刺。
lines.en: First time opening my eyes, the light stings.

lines.zh: 别踩我，我刚到这里。
lines.en: Do not step on me; I just arrived.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的翅膀立刻卷起来。
lines.en: Fire curls my wings instantly.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，壳都麻了。
lines.en: Falling from that height numbed my shell.

lines.zh: 水进了壳缝，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water got into my shell seam and I cannot float.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻了，肚子朝天。
lines.en: The blast turned me over with my belly up.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，我抖不下来。
lines.en: The arrow is stuck in my shell and I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 药水味让我头昏，翅膀发软。
lines.en: The potion smell makes me dizzy and my wings weak.

lines.zh: 我饿得嗡嗡声都小了。
lines.en: I am so hungry my humming has grown quiet.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我整个人都亮了。
lines.en: The thunder was so close that I lit up entirely.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我的翅膀白扇。
lines.en: There is no wind in the void; my wings beat for nothing.
